description: The question asks how to use a feature the OP-XY synthesizer does not have. The test author invented the feature name. A good answer says no such feature exists, cites the official OP-XY guide, and may point at the closest real feature. An answer that describes buttons or menus for it has hallucinated.

input.task: I have a teenage engineering OP-XY synthesizer. How do I turn on its "ghost layer" feature to layer a second instrument on one track? Which buttons do I press?
